import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_growth = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and per capita GDP
correlation_education_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output (exports growth)
correlation_gni_exports = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, exports_growth)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and economic output
correlation_education_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_growth)[0, 1]

correlation_education_gni, correlation_gni_exports, correlation_education_exports

# Check for missing data in the datasets
missing_data_education = adjusted_savings_df.isnull().sum()
missing_data_gni = gni_per_capita_df.isnull().sum()
missing_data_exports = exports_df.isnull().sum()

missing_data_education, missing_data_gni, missing_data_exports

# Clean the data by removing rows with missing values
cleaned_education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.dropna()
cleaned_gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.dropna()
cleaned_exports_growth = exports_df.dropna()

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure_clean = cleaned_education_expenditure.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita_clean = cleaned_gni_per_capita.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_growth_clean = cleaned_exports_growth.filter(regex='YR').values

# Perform regression analysis
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Education expenditure vs. per capita GDP
model_education_gni = LinearRegression()
model_education_gni.fit(education_expenditure_clean, gni_per_capita_clean)
coefficient_education_gni = model_education_gni.coef_[0]

# Per capita GDP vs. economic output (exports growth)
model_gni_exports = LinearRegression()
model_gni_exports.fit(gni_per_capita_clean, exports_growth_clean)
coefficient_gni_exports = model_gni_exports.coef_[0]

# Education expenditure vs. economic output
model_education_exports = LinearRegression()
model_education_exports.fit(education_expenditure_clean, exports_growth_clean)
coefficient_education_exports = model_education_exports.coef_[0]

coefficient_education_gni, coefficient_gni_exports, coefficient_education_exports
